name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text:
Add a 1-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity for interactive elements.

This keeps the focus indicator visible on all backgrounds while staying lightweight—glow adds clarity without heavy motion. Trade-off: the glow subtly increases visual noise, but it’s worth it for users who rely on clear focus cues.

name: Reader
text: Glow at 20% opacity risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on light backgrounds—#005FCC at 20% drops contrast too low. Drop the glow, use a 2px solid #005FCC ring at 30% opacity instead; it stays visible without motion and meets contrast on all backgrounds. Test with Playwright MCP on light and dark themes to confirm.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 2-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring at 30% opacity with no glow. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on light and dark backgrounds while staying lightweight. Trade-off: it’s less flashy than a glow, but clarity beats decoration—users need reliable focus cues, not eye candy.

name: Reader
text: The 2px solid ring at 30% still risks fading into light backgrounds when zoomed—especially on high-contrast mode or custom system themes. A better alternative: use a 3px solid ring at 20% opacity, which maintains visibility without glow while passing WCAG 2.2 AA on both light and dark themes. Settle it with Playwright MCP tests on 100% zoom, forced colors mode, and at least 3 light/dark theme pairs.
